REFERENCES

1. IEEE Standard 344-1975, "Recommended Practices for Seismic Qualifica-
tion of Class 1E Equipment for Nuclear Power Generating Stations,
January 1975.

2. Roundtree, R.C., and Safford, F.B., "Methodology and Standardiza-
tion for Fragility Evaluation," Shock and Vibration Bulletin No. 41,
Part 5, December 1970.

3. Kana, D.D., and Pomerening, D.J., "Correlation of Methodologies for
Seismic Qualification Tests of Nuclear Plant Equipment," Report No.
SwRI-6582-002, Task 2 Summary Report, Contract NRC-04-81-185, South-
west Research Institute, June 1, 1983.

4. Kana, D.D., and Pomerening, D.J., "Recommendations for Improvement
of Equipment Qualification Methodology and Criteria," Report No.
SwRI 6582-003, Task 3 Summary Report, Contract NRC-04-81-185,
Southwest Research Institute, August 1983.

5. Kana, D.D., and Pomerening, D.J., "Suitability of Synthesized Wave-
forms for Seismic Qualification of Equipment," Paper No. 83-PVP-22,
ASME Pressure Vessels and Piping Technology Conference, Portland,
Oregon, June 1983 (to appear in ASME Journal of Pressure Vessel
and Piping Technology).

6. Unruh, J.F., and Kana, D.D., "An Iterative Procedure for the Genera-
tion of Consistent Power/Response Spectrum," Nuclear Engineering and
Design, 66 (1981), pp 427-435.

7. Azarm, M., Boccio, J., Farahzad, P., "Identification of Seismically
Risk Sensitive Systems and Components in Nuclear Power Plants,"
NUREG/CR-3357, BNL-NUREG-51683, Brookhaven National Laboratory,
June 1983.

8. Kennedy, R.P., et al, "Subsystem Fragility," Seismic Safety Margins
Research Program-Phase I," Report No. NUREG/CR-2405, UCRL-15407,
Lawrence Livermore Laboratory, February 1982.

9. Hardy, G.S., and Campbell, R.D., "Development of Fragility Descrip-
tions of Equipment for Seismic Risk Assessment of Nuclear Power
Plants," Paper No. 83-PVP-13, ASME Pressure Vessels and Piping Tech-
nology Conference, Portland, Oregon, June 1983.

10. HNDTR-73-8-ED-R, Waveform Synthesis Technique for Safeguard TSE Systems
and Equipment, U.S. Army Corps of Engineers, Huntsville Division,
1 May 1973.

11. HNDDSP-72-72-ED-R, Test Specification and Procedure for Transient Vi-
bration Failure Threshold (Fragility) Testing of Safeguard Electric
Motor Control Center C-1 (ITC E87MC), U.S. Army Corps of Engineers,
Huntsville Division, Boeing Aerospace Contract No. DACA87-72-C-0002,
March 30, 1973.

12. Personal communication with R.D. Campbell, Structural Mechanics
Associates.
